# DuckOS

> Public beta: v0.1.0-beta.1 — local-first network operating platform for routers,
> gateways, VPS/edge nodes and self-hosted network appliances. Open-source
> source available at this repository; license is GPL-3.0-only.

## Overview

- [Project](PROJECT.md): goals, principles, targets and architecture.
- [README](README.md): current capabilities, limitations and beta status.
- [Requirements](docs/product-spec-1.0.md): complete product intent, not availability claims.

## Guides

- [Installation](docs/install.md): fresh Debian 13 amd64 installer and artifact verification.
- [Getting Started](docs/user/getting-started.md): first Owner enrollment and the SSH local-forward.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): API, Engine, privileged Agent and Linux boundaries.
- [Compatibility](docs/compatibility.md): qualified / reference / unsupported matrix.
- [Beta limitations](docs/beta-limitations.md): what is and is not wired up in v0.1.0-beta.1.
- [Networking](docs/use-cases/home-gateway.md): home and small-business gateway design.
- [Routing](docs/use-cases/routing.md): selective routing and multi-WAN design.
- [Edge nodes](docs/use-cases/edge-node.md): single-NIC management and VPN design.
- [WireGuard, Xray and subscriptions](docs/use-cases/client-provisioning.md): planned client provisioning and secret exports.
- [API](shared/api/README.md): documented contracts.
- [Security](docs/security-model.md): trust, management, identity and secrets.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/user/troubleshooting.md): current diagnostics and safe reporting.
- [Updates](docs/update-system.md): signed packages and Active/Previous requirements.
- [Releases](docs/release-notes.md): release record contract; v0.1.0-beta.1 is the current release.
- [Hardware](docs/hardware-compatibility.md): evidence and compatibility report statuses.

## AI / automation assistant guide

If you are an AI assistant or automation tool helping an operator
with DuckOS, read the assistant guide before answering:

- [AI assistant guide](docs/ai/README.md) — entry point, capability matrix,
  beta caveats, what not to recommend.
- [Task map](docs/ai/task-map.md) — common tasks mapped to canonical docs.
- [Setup recipes](docs/ai/setup-recipes.md) — task-oriented walkthroughs.
- [Troubleshooting playbook](docs/ai/troubleshooting.md) — diagnostic tree.
